task_definition.title: result-fallback β: recovery-combinator evaluation over Value::Option
task_definition.description: Layer A task β of PRD docs/prds/v0_6/result-and-fallback.md §8. Implement evaluation of the recovery combinators over Value::Option (three-state some/none/undef, spec §9.2.8). Tag-driven recovery (contract C-1): some(x)->x, none->default/alternative, undef-of-Option->undef (D2 undef passthrough — only a DETERMINED none recovers, mirroring §9.2.4). Pure + eager (C-2). MUST NOT read Freshness (INV-1 orthogonality). Likely implemented as reify-expr intrinsics rather than pure .ri bodies because the some(v)/none match form is itself a grammar gap today (DCE F4); decide at impl (Q1).
